description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Baral's Expertise, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand, and casting Naru Meha from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
